notes.title: Old Sparky spotted in Gotchi Guardians!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684698/94731ae215703658f85d29af31e75ad3ee283492.png"]Old Sparky Update is Live!
What New?

New Boss - Old Sparky: a new franken style giant sparky has started to appear in Gotchi Guardians

New Shortcuts & Settings: New shortcuts have been added to enrich the PC experience with the ability for players to remap

New Tutorial: Faster, shorter and teaches the game from a different perspective

Balance Changes: Fun changes to items and licks have been added to make the game feel better



This update brings more features and balance changes, which you can learn more about in our Patch Notes

notes.title: Gotchi Guardians is available now!
notes.content:
Gotchi Guardians is now available on Steam for everyone! 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684698/31d470aee6568d7ec1fbae18d6c1c613298ca953.png"]

It's been a journey for our small indie-sized team to bring the game to this point over the last 2 years, but it's finally here!



Are there bugs?

sure...



Is the game perfect?

no...



Is it fun?

hell yes!



With this release, all our core features and systems are fully functional.

Are you ready to join us on an adventure as we continue to improve this game into something truly exceptional?

Join our Discord, where we can help you troubleshoot any issues you encounter.

Have some feedback? Send it our way, and we will use it to make the game even better.

Most importantly, we hope you guys have as much of a blast playing Gotchi Guardians as we've had making it!



We already have several big updates planned over the coming months for you guys to look forward to.



The next update will focus on adding more towers and licks to add new challenges and tools for players.



Here's a concept art of our upcoming tower, the Stohn Nest. Can you guess what it will be?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684698/3d957dafa7185d5cb9eac7d3250d36f57d84aabf.png"]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 is live!
notes.content:
1.0.2 Shaaman Too Good (and moar)Overview
This patch focuses on balancing the game and fixing some minor bugs. Hopefully it speeds up the game a bit, improves the difficulty curve, and stops the Shaaman for getting over 700% tower damage buff!

We also made significant progress in squashing bugs related to earning progression of XP, Badges, and star progression.



For more details, you can read the full patch notes

notes.title: Minor Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
1.0.1 Overview
While this patch focuses on various fixes, it also hopes to address some of our players' more vocal concerns.



For more details, you can read them here

Overview
Two years in the making, Gotchi Guardians is leaving Alpha behind!

With this update, the game is now feature-complete—though we’ll still be squashing bugs. To celebrate this milestone, we’re proud to bring you version 1.0.0, our biggest update yet!

What’s new in 1.0.0

A brand-new map to explore

Exciting events that shake up the gameplay

Deeper, guardian-specific mechanics and challenges

Our most significant balance pass to date—gameplay feels smoother than ever

Launch of the standalone Steam version

Coming soon

Rapid fire of bug fixes based on your feedback

A new tower, a lickquidator, and a boss fight

Even more events

A new guardian with more items

…and much more!

Your support drives everything we do—there’s no shortage of ideas for fun new content!



For more details on all the changes that come with 1.0.0 you can find them here:
https://aavegotchi.notion.site/1-0-0-Release-Patch-23488105b41280e3ae94d416d97aac4f
